name: Golan
overview: Golan, located in Bashan, was assigned to the half-tribe of Manasseh and designated as a Levitical city and a city of refuge. This special status provided a place of safety for those who had unintentionally caused a death, reflecting God's provision for justice and mercy within Israel. The allocation of Golan alongside Bezer and Ramoth in Gilead highlights its role in the broader system of cities of refuge given to the Levites and the tribes east of the Jordan.
